title: Miami spots that don't feel like Miami
igCaption:
Send this to your friend who says there's nothing to do in Miami 🌴

Vizcaya: an Italian Renaissance villa and gardens on Biscayne Bay
Venetian Pool: a public pool from 1924 you can swim in
Fairchild: 83 acres of rare tropical plants
Matheson Hammock: 630 acres of park on Old Cutler Road

Pick one for this weekend and tag who you're taking.

#Miami #CoralGables #MiamiThingsToDo #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: Send this to your friend who says there's nothing to do in Miami. These places don't even feel like Miami.

scenes.text: Vizcaya, in Coconut Grove. It's James Deering's old villa, right on Biscayne Bay. The gardens are Italian Renaissance style. It feels like Europe.
scenes.caption: Vizcaya, in Coconut Grove. It's James Deering's old villa, right on Biscayne Bay. The gardens are Italian Renaissance style. It feels like Europe.

scenes.text: Venetian Pool, in Coral Gables. It's a public pool, finished in 1924. And yes, you can actually swim in it.
scenes.caption: Venetian Pool, in Coral Gables. It's a public pool, finished in 1924. And yes, you can actually swim in it.

scenes.text: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. Eighty-three acres of rare tropical plants. Palms, cycads, flowering trees and vines.
scenes.caption: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden. Eighty-three acres of rare tropical plants. Palms, cycads, flowering trees and vines.

scenes.text: Right around it is Matheson Hammock Park. Six hundred thirty acres of park, on Old Cutler Road.
scenes.caption: Right around it is Matheson Hammock Park. Six hundred thirty acres of park, on Old Cutler Road.
